checks.title: Business rules (API)

checks.title: Add a store
steps: Code WH1, Name Warehouse 1, Location Pune
checks.expect: The store appears; codes are shown in capitals; a duplicate code is refused.

checks.title: Units of measure
steps: Open Master › Inventory Setup › Units of Measure
Edit a product (Master › Products) and set Unit = NOS
checks.expect: The product list shows NOS in the Unit column; deleting NOS is refused while a product uses it.

checks.title: Receipt: draft then submit
checks.expect: Draft gets a number like SE-00001; after Submit the status is Submitted and Stock Position shows 10 in Warehouse 1 worth ₹2,500.
checks.auto: e2e inventory.spec.ts; InventoryTests › Receipts average the rate

checks.title: Moving average
steps: Make a second receipt of SKU-0001 into Warehouse 1: 10 @ 350
checks.expect: Warehouse 1 shows 20 with valuation rate ₹300 and value ₹6,000.

checks.title: Transfer and issue
steps: New entry, type Transfer, from Warehouse 1 to Main Store, 5 × SKU-0001, Submit
New entry, type Issue, from Warehouse 1, 100 × SKU-0001, Submit
checks.expect: The transfer moves 5 at ₹300; the issue is refused with 'Insufficient stock … 15 available, 100 needed' and nothing moves.
checks.auto: InventoryTests › Transfer moves stock; Issuing more than the store holds

checks.title: Cancel reverses
checks.expect: Status becomes Cancelled; the ledger shows Reversal rows; stock returns to what it was (refused if that stock was already used).

checks.title: Rights
checks.expect: No access. In Master › Role Rights, giving User Read+Write on Stock Entries lets staff create drafts but not Submit (needs Update) or Cancel (needs Delete).
checks.auto: InventoryTests › User role reads stock but cannot create entries

checks.title: Stock position

checks.expect: Totals (lines, quantity, value) follow the filters; rows below 10 show a Low tag.

checks.title: Stock ledger

login: admin@demo.com / Admin@123 (SuperAdmin), manager@demo.com / Manager@123 (Admin), staff@demo.com / Staff@1234 (User)

checks.title: First visit asks for a passphrase
steps: Enter the same passphrase (10+ characters) twice
checks.expect: The conversation list opens with the Announcements and General channels. Opening Messages again does not ask for the passphrase.

checks.title: Members chat privately, the SuperAdmin can join chats
steps: As manager@demo.com set up Messages, click New, pick Demo Staff, Start chat, send a message
As staff@demo.com open the chat and reply
As admin@demo.com open Messages, click New, pick Demo Staff, send a message
checks.expect: Both members see the messages live. The SuperAdmin doesn't see the manager-staff chat, but can start their own; staff can reply to it.

checks.title: Messaging senior roles needs a right
steps: As admin@demo.com open User Rights for Demo Staff, give Write on 'Message Senior Roles', save
As staff@demo.com reload Messages and click New
checks.expect: At first staff only sees other Users in the people list. After the right is granted, Admin, Manager and SuperAdmin people appear and a chat can be started.

checks.title: General channel is for everyone
steps: As admin@demo.com and manager@demo.com open General
checks.expect: Everyone sees the message live and can reply in General.

checks.title: Announcements are one-way
checks.expect: Staff sees the announcement and 'Only the organization owner can post here.' with no message box.

checks.title: Same messages in the desktop app
steps: Sign in to the desktop app as staff@demo.com
Open Messages and unlock with the same passphrase
checks.expect: The same conversations and messages appear; new messages arrive live in both apps.

checks.title: The server only stores ciphertext
steps: In psql: SELECT ciphertext FROM chat_messages ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1;
checks.expect: Random-looking base64, never the message text.

Enter the 6-digit code and click Turn on

checks.title: Remember this device for 30 days

Sign out and sign in again in the same browser (or desktop app)
checks.expect: The same browser/app signs in with the password only; another browser still asks for the code. Settings > Two-factor shows 'Remembered devices: 1'; 'Forget all remembered devices' makes it ask again.

steps: Sign in and enter one recovery code instead of the app code
Sign out and try the same recovery code again
checks.expect: The first time signs you in; the second time is refused.

checks.title: Edit lower roles only
